create_tool_sampler_with_calculator: create a ToolSampler with a Calculator tool and chat with a math prompt
chat_with_tool_sampler: chat with a ToolSampler instance using a prompt and optional images
customize_tool_manager_class: customize the ToolSampler manager_cls to handle system prompts and tools differently
enable_streaming_output: enable print_stream on ToolSampler chat to stream output as it is generated
use_multi_turn_conversation: use multi_turn mode on ToolSampler chat to reuse previous turns as context
